name: Prepare an idempotent ingest batch
title: Prepare an idempotent ingest batch
description:
Create a batch only after agreeing the source scope and a stable idempotency key with the ingest operator. Attach a private manifest or provide the supported manifest JSON, validate item keys and storage references, and check archive settings before queueing. The idempotency key prevents retries from creating duplicate assets.

Use a small test batch first, then inspect status, processed count, timestamps, and error log. A failed batch should be investigated and safely retried using the same idempotency identity where the ingestion contract says it is safe. Avoid placing credentials in manifests or error text.
